desc: Prove the exact characterization of legal edges, including edges joining distinct connected components.
Derive the optimal-play winner criterion using component bipartition sizes and a rigorous parity or pairing-strategy proof.
Analyze small configurations and validate the criterion for disconnected components and isolated vertices.
Design an \(O(N+M)\) method to compute component sizes, bipartitions, and edge statistics.
Implement the proven algorithm in Python with fast I/O.
Verify the implementation against all provided samples and relevant corner cases.
